definitions.explanation: The ninth month of the year. The new school term resumes after summer vacation. Features the autumn equinox.

examples.japanese: {九月|くがつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{九月|くがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しく→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{九月|くがつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まります→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{九月|くがつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going on a trip at the end of September.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九月|くがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{終|お}わります→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, once September comes, you start to feel autumn, and the summer heat gradually ends.

notes:
{九月|くがつ} is September, the ninth month. Note the reading is く, not きゅう.

CULTURAL NOTES:
- School resumes after summer vacation
- ⟦{秋分|しゅうぶん}→秋分：19657_shuubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Autumn Equinox Day) around Sept. 23rd is a national holiday
- Beginning of autumn (⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧) in Japan

MONTH PATTERN:
All months follow the pattern: [number] + ⟦{月|がつ}→月：noentry⟧
- ⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧: August
- {九月|くがつ}: September
- ⟦{十月|じゅうがつ}→十月：00634_juugatsu⟧: October

NOTE:
{九|く} is used (not {九|きゅう}) for September.
